caption: Home: Basic, Slash pre-picked from Cleave, live preset grid; Save & use is the 3-tap path.
A layer selected: only the Sparks layer's 3 sliders show, plus Take from / Roll this layer / Shelf it.
Advanced beat row (Cast · Travel · Hit · Linger). Travel shows a still path: 'Travel arrives in a later update'.
Hit beat sheet: take this beat from another effect, nudge ±30 ms, start here, tap the rhythm.
Mid-drag (touch): hold Frost shard, drag it onto Fireball; the target says 'Drop to blend'.
Default blend sheet: parent row with a leads marker and Swap, a Mix slider that snaps to 0/25/50/75/100, a slim Steam Try line, and Fine-tune parts. Per-part A/B/Both is not on this sheet.
Fine-tune parts: framed A/B/Both with an inset selected pill (~4 px padding) and 8 px gaps between rows; all six parts fit; Layer/Beat uses the same pill.
While blending, tapping the Colour chip opens a small A/B/Both popover with a live preview. The default blend sheet stays open.
Shape and Trail set to Both: the meter turns amber, names the overflow, and offers one-tap 'Fit to budget'.
After Fit (rule 4): one line says “Trimmed 2 linger steps, trail by 2 to fit” with Undo. Particles were already in cap and were not cut by step. Never silent.
Long-press Thunder pillar: Take its sparks / colour / motion / timing, Blend into current, Shelf it.
Taken layer keeps an origin chip: 'from Fireball'. It is a copy; nothing updates on its own.
Source edited: the chip reads 'Fireball changed · Update?' and the layer chip gets an amber dot. One tap pulls it, one Undo.
Source deleted: 'source removed'. The effect keeps its own copy and still plays.
Shelf (references only, 6 of 48, this project): hearted effects and a one-part Colour layer with from pointing at its source. Liking is not using.
Variation dice: seeded rerolls inside the layers' bounds; last 6 rolls on this device, tap one to step back.
House style on Fireball: Moonlit @4 fire (no pink), chunky, motes. Particle meter reads 34/32 particles (preset cap) on one line with draws and steps, goes amber and offers Fit.
After Fit on the same Fireball: “Trimmed particles 34→32 to fit” with Undo. The preset cap holds.
Lab: bold ideas with a live budget pill each (fits / over → Fit). World-aware linger and Draw the spell marked later.
Lab, lower half: tiers, reactions, combo fusion, living linger, later ideas.
Breed Fireball × Frost shard: 6 children, 3 at a time; each flips one or two discrete picks (kind, picture or ramp) from variant_seed so they look clearly different.
Combo fusion preview: two casters, and at the hit a ready-made fused look (Steam burst) swaps in. Not a live blend.
Living linger (visual only) spreads to 4 tiles and goes over 60 draws: flagged, with Fit to budget.
Power-up tier Lv3 of Fireball: extra steps switch on, 13/12 steps is flagged on the one-line meter and Fit is offered. Later: value scaling. Save is refused while over.
After Fit: “Trimmed 1 linger step to fit” with Undo. The meter reads 11/12 steps, so Lv3 can never save at 13.
Export: 8-frame sprite sheet, GIF later; 'Export clean' drops the 'from' links, the look stays.
Tap the rhythm (Advanced): five taps set the beat lengths, snapped to 30 ms; the beat row shows the nudges.
Variant B (URL ?blend=chips): same Mix and parents, no Fine-tune row; the top chips are the only per-part control. One-time coach: “Tap a part to pick A, B or Both”.
